question: Madhavi Mudgal is associated with which classical dance of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Classical dance forms in India include Bharatnatyam, Kuchipudi, Odissi, Kathakali, Mohiniyattam etc.
 
• **Odissi is a classical dance from the Odisha** state which follows Natya Sastra principles.
 
 
• **Sonal Mansingh, Sujata Mohapatra**, and **Madhavi Mudgal **are among the famous Odissi dancers in India.** Hence option 3 is correct.**
 
 
 
• Madhavi Mudgal is a classical dancer in Odissi, but she also learnt Bharatnatyam and Kathak.
 
• She won the Sanskriti Award in 1984, **Padma Sri Award in 1990** and the Orissa state Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2000.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manipuri is a classical dance from Manipur** state and is based on Vaishnavism, Shaktism and Shaivism.

 
 
• Raas, Nata Sankirtan, Dhola Cholam etc are the types of Manipuri dance styles.
 
 
 
• **Lai Haraoba is the earliest dance in Manipur and is the oldest festival celebrated there.**
 
• Guru Bipin Sinha and Darshana Jhaveri are among the famous Manipuri dancers.
 
• **Kathak is one of the major classical dance form that has roots in the north India and it has its origin in the Uttar Pradesh state.**
 
• Rohini Bhate, Sitara Devi, Sunder Prasad are some of the famous Kathak dancers.
 
• **Sattriya dance form is originated in Assam** and was introduced by Mahapurusha Sankaradeva, a vaishnavaite from Assam.
